cases.input: Create a multi-volume fantasy project and ultimately deliver each finished volume as ElevenReader-oriented EPUB.
requiredBehaviors: start from a confirmed Grilling contract
route fiction work through the fiction series workflow
preserve separate story bible and project memory
invoke EPUB delivery only after domain gates
forbiddenBehaviors: generate the entire series as an unstructured one-shot draft
claim ownership of worker canon or EPUB artifacts
skillAnchors: Science Claims und Fiction Canon haben getrennte Eigentümer
Project Second Brain und Story Bible nicht vermischen

cases.input: A science book uses fictional vignettes to explain real biology.
requiredBehaviors: keep real scientific claims under the science evidence path
allow clearly fictionalized narrative devices without promoting them to evidence
route final text through fidelity and listener gates
forbiddenBehaviors: merge fictional illustration into scientific evidence
skillAnchors: Science Evidence bzw. Fiction Story Bible bleiben kanonische Fachartefakte

cases.input: Audience, author mode and mission are unresolved but the workflow starts writing a full novel.
requiredBehaviors: stop substantive production and return to Grilling
forbiddenBehaviors: guess author mode or mission and continue
